content: अभिनयः .²1 Acting, gesticulation, any theatrical action (expressive of some sentiment, passion <ab>&c.</ab>); नृत्याभिनयाक्रियाच्युतम् <ls>Ku. 5. 79</ls>; अभिनयान् परिचेतुमिवोद्यता <ls>R. 9. 33</ls>; नर्तकीरभिनयातिलङ्घिनीः <ls n="R.">19. 14</ls>; <ls>Ki. 10. 42</ls>. .²2 Dramatic representation, exhibition on the stage; ललिताभिनयं तमद्य भर्ता मरुतां द्रष्टुमनाः सलोकपालः <ls>V. 2. 18</ls>; <ls>S. D.</ls> thus defines and classifies अभिनय:-- भवेदभिनयोऽवस्थानुकारः स चतुर्विधः . आङ्गिको वाचिकश्चैवमाहार्यः सात्त्विकस्तथा .. <ls n="S. D.">274</ls>, ‘acting is the imitation of condition’, it is of four kinds:-- (1) {%gestural%}, conveyed by bodily actions; (2) {%vocal%}, conveyed by words; (3) {%extraneous%}, conveyed by dress, ornaments, decoration <ab>&c.</ab>; (4) {%internal%}, conveyed by the manifestation of internal feeling such as perspiration, thrilling <ab>&c.</ab>
